parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented police or border targeting of visitors, and documented social acceptance (decade of Pride, majority marriage-support polls, 2022 conversion-practice ban, openly operating NGOs) are meaningful positives. But the visitor-facing protections are thin: no SOGI discrimination law, no documented working remedy (compensation, prosecution), routine ID-mismatch scrutiny at healthcare encounters, government surveillance of LGBTIQ groups, vague penal articles used for 43 arrests in 2025, and a 2025 Pride clampdown in the largest city signalling backsliding. Prison placement, border screening and violence rates against visitors are open questions, not established exposures; the LGR gap and student-discrimination data are resident-sphere. Social acceptance without operating protections and with a deteriorating official climate places this just under the 0.65 tier.
